name: delay_pre_delay
description: Short pre-delay — pushes reverb back, separates dry source from reverb tail
notes: 25ms single echo at mix 1.0 (insert): the dry signal is delayed by 25ms before entering the reverb chain. Use by running apply_delay first (insert mode, no mix blend needed since mix=1.0 replaces the signal), then apply_reverb on the output. This separates the dry hit from the reverb onset, improving clarity. Typical pre-delay: 15-30ms for snare, 10-20ms for vocals.
